subject: Re: Performance at Scale webinar — quick demo to map to Starlane use case
messages:
From: Ariel Gomez <ariel@starlane.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Performance at Scale webinar — interested in a quick demo

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the webinar today — the latency/cost graphs during the Q&A were especially helpful. I’m leading infra/platform at Starlane and we’re evaluating options to serve a 99% P95 < 150ms SLA for our chat assistant while keeping token costs predictable.

Would love a short demo to see how Redwood’s routing and batching might map to our traffic pattern (bursty peak after product launches). We’re small engineering team but moving fast — a 30 minute screen-share next week would be ideal.

Quick notes: we need basic SOC 2 evidence and a sense of private deployment options for PCI-adjacent workflows. I attached a short list of security questions our procurement team normally uses.

Best,
Ariel

Attachment: starlane-security-questions.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Ariel Gomez <ariel@starlane.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance at Scale webinar — interested in a quick demo

Hi Ariel — great to meet you and thanks for joining the webinar.

I’m looping in Tessa (our Solutions SDR) who can book the demo and tailor the agenda. High level: we can cover a short walkthrough of the runtime, a routing/cost map for your traffic profile, and a quick note on Private deployment and SOC 2 artifacts.

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 9/15, 10:00–10:30am
- Wed 9/15, 3:00–3:30pm
- Thu 9/16, 1:00–1:30pm

If one of those works, Tessa will send a calendar invite + agenda. If not, feel free to pick a slot on our Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m

FYI I’ve added Ben Carter (AE) to help with procurement/terms questions during the call if needed.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference

--

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the quick reply and for looping Tessa in.

The Wed 9/15 morning slot is promising but can we push to a slightly later time? Our CTO has a standing all-hands at 10am PT. Would 11:30am PT on 9/15 work instead? Also timezone check: we’re Pacific as well.

On SOC 2: please send any public artifact links you can share ahead of the call and the name of the contact on your compliance team so we can scope an NDA/procurement thread. I attached the list of questions for context.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.
Ariel

Subject: Confirmed: Redwood demo for Starlane — Tue 9/15 11:30am PT (30m)

Hi Ariel — thanks for the quick reply and for the SOC list. 11:30am PT on 9/15 works for us; I’ve put a 30-minute hold on the calendar.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m intros & goals (Starlane constraints)
- 10m runtime walkthrough (routing, batching, fallbacks)
- 10m mapping to your traffic profile + cost sketch
- 5m next steps (procurement artifacts / POC cadence)

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, redwood-demo-deck.pdf
Calendar invite: calendar-invite.ics (stub)

If you need a stub NDA or SOC contact ahead of time, Ben is looping in the security contact and can follow up after the call.

See you Wed 9/15 at 11:30am PT (calendar invite will include a Google Meet link).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Solutions SDR — Redwood Inference
